title: The daily positions of one GPS station, east, north and up, from the Nevada Geodetic Laboratory
provider: Nevada Geodetic Laboratory, University of Nevada, Reno

p123.description: station P123, New Mexico, as an example

on_demand.description: the daily positions of a GPS station since it began

format: tenv3 text (https://geodesy.unr.edu/gps_timeseries/readmes/README_tenv3.txt), one day a line: site, date, decimal year, MJD, GPS week and day, reference meridian; easting, northing and vertical position in metres as an integer and a fractional part each (graticule distance coordinates; Blewitt 2024); antenna height; east, north and up sigma (m); correlations; nominal latitude, longitude and height.
coverage: One station, daily, from its first day
licence: No licence is stated; the data are supplied as is. Cite Blewitt, Hammond and Kreemer (2018), and the station's own data citation where it has one.
citation: Blewitt, G., Hammond, W. C. and Kreemer, C. (2018), Harnessing the GPS data explosion for interdisciplinary science, Eos 99, doi:10.1029/2018EO104623.
